items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: That we made a recording with Sharky? ... Dave Frank wrote that.

ctx.x: Ted's been very sick. What about the Rolls? Did they sell the Rolls in the piano department? Ted's been very sick. Oh yes. Ted's been very sick. They sold right there together? Ted's been very sick. I was wondering about how the place was set up.
Ted's been very sick. No, no. I take it back. Dave Frank sold the Rolls. Now, with each piano you got 25 Rolls. I see. So... Ted's been one of those shotguns in there. I won selling player pianos.
Who gave that to you? The Whirlands or the company?
